test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_prewhere_json_compact ( id UInt64, activity_id Int64, event JSON(max_dynamic_paths = 64, `metadata.event_code` String) ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = '100G', auto_statistics_types = 'basic, uniq_v2'
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_prewhere_json_compact SELECT number, 1 + 2 * (number % 10), concat('{"metadata":{"event_code":"c', toString(number % 50), '"},', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(i -> concat('"g', toString((number * 7 + i * 13) % 300), '":{"v":"', repeat('v', 10 + i % 20), toString(number % 1000), '"}'), range(60)), ','), '}') FROM numbers(2000000) SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 4
test.query: SELECT count() FROM t_prewhere_json_compact WHERE activity_id = 12 AND event.metadata.event_code = 'no-such-code'
SELECT count() FROM t_prewhere_json_compact WHERE activity_id = 12 AND event.g95.v = 'no-such-value'
